chunks.title: PostgreSQL Documentation: Transaction Isolation
chunks.excerpt: Read Committed is the default isolation level in PostgreSQL. When a transaction uses this isolation level, a SELECT query (without a FOR UPDATE/SHARE clause) sees only data committed before the query began; it never sees either uncommitted data or changes committed by concurrent transactions during the query's execution.

chunks.title: PostgreSQL Documentation: Transaction Isolation
chunks.excerpt: A transaction reads data written by a concurrent uncommitted transaction.
